---
id: fixture-01
title: Crane lift of a container to a supply vessel
---
| # | Step | Hazards | Controls |
|---|------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Hold pre-lift meeting | Miscommunication between crane operator, rigger and vessel crew | Lift plan reviewed with all crew; radio channel agreed with vessel |
| 2 | Rig the container | Pinch points; dropped load from damaged rigging | Certified slings inspected before use; gloves |
| 3 | Lift and swing the load over the side | Load swinging into structure; crane overload | Load weight confirmed against load chart; signalman in sight of operator |
| 4 | Land the container on the vessel deck | Vessel movement in swell; struck by load | Lift only within vessel motion limits; deck crew stand clear until load is landed |
